title: Ice water drowning survival of young patient (2025)
summary: A medical case study from JACC Case Reports documenting the successful survival of a young patient after ice water drowning, demonstrating the protective effects of cold water submersion and hypothermia on human physiology.
problem_solved: Provides clinical insights into ice water drowning survival mechanisms and optimal resuscitation strategies for cold water submersion incidents.
why_valuable: Offers documented evidence of successful outcomes in pediatric ice water drowning cases, contributing valuable data to emergency medicine protocols and hypothermic preservation research.
